three_population_tracking_contract.Population_1_All_Eligible: Denominator for decision coverage reporting. Includes all eligible IPOs closing during evaluation window.
three_population_tracking_contract.Population_2_Clean_Prospective: IPOs with verified pre-cutoff timestamps and documents. Primary leakage-controlled evaluation cohort.
three_population_tracking_contract.Population_3_Excluded_Unverified: Retained for transparency, reporting coverage, exclusion reasons, and selection bias audits.

four_tier_reporting_standard.Tier_2_Observed_Allotment: Empirical retail allotment experience from official registrar basis circulars.
four_tier_reporting_standard.Tier_3_Actual_Execution: Realized broker fills, actual opening auction slippage, and exchange transaction fees (Prohibited in shadow mode).
four_tier_reporting_standard.Tier_4_Simulated_Scenario: Hypothetical sensitivity matrix under deterministic SHA-256 uniform draws.

future_production_acceptance_hurdles.brier_skill_score_rule: Point estimate BSS > 0.0 and 95% bootstrap confidence interval lower bound > 0.0
future_production_acceptance_hurdles.severe_loss_event_requirement: N_severe >= 25 with demonstrated catch rate statistically superior to base rate
future_production_acceptance_hurdles.operational_review_requirement: Independent formal review and audit document; no automatic authorization.
